## The routes agree

Modules whose outcome and first reason are the same by two routes, and whose census is the same set of reasons. The census's order is the order the reasons were met, which follows each reader's numbering of symbols (`hod_ll` numbers a symbol at its first mention, `hod_bc` in record order); the last column counts the modules whose census is in the same order by all three routes.

| LLVM | modules | text = native | native = `llvm-dis` | census: text = native | census: native = `llvm-dis` | census in the same order |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| 22 | 3347 | 3347 | 3346 | 3347 | 3346 | 3346 |
| 19 | 3308 | 3308 | 3307 | 3308 | 3307 | 3307 |

The modules that differ (at most 20):

- `kiln/llvm22/conformance/temp.arg.nontype/class-type-argument-debuginfo-run.cpp.ll`: text `-` (-), native `-` (-), `llvm-dis` `malformed-input` (malformed-input)
- `kiln/llvm19/conformance/temp.arg.nontype/class-type-argument-debuginfo-run.cpp.ll`: text `-` (-), native `-` (-), `llvm-dis` `malformed-input` (malformed-input)
